'''CE FLNG Terminal Pipelines''' is a shelved natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref name="r970658">{{Cite web|url=https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2025-01/CE%20FLNG%20LLC%20-%20Notice%20of%20Dismissal%20-%20GC-FECM%20FINAL%2001-17-25.pdf|title=CE FLNG, LLC Notice of Dismissal, DOE Office of Fossil Energy and Carbon Management, January 17, 2025|website=energy.gov|access-date=2026-11-05}}</ref><ref name="r670edf">{{Cite web|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240417084250/https://www.cefcp-h2m.com/about-1|title=https://web.archive.org/web/20240417084250/https://www.cefcp-h2m.com/about-1|website=web.archive.org|access-date=2026-11-05}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is located in Louisiana.<ref name="rd05654">{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2013/12/12/2013-29600/ce-flng-llc-ce-pipeline-llc-notice-of-intent-to-prepare-an-environmental-impact-statement-for-the|title=CE FLNG, LLC, CE Pipeline, LLC; Notice of Intent To Prepare an Environmental Impact Statement for the Planned CE FLNG Project|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-05}}</ref><ref name="r970658" />

==Background==
CE Pipeline LLC planned about 37 miles of 42-inch natural gas pipeline in Plaquemines Parish, Louisiana. It would have served the proposed CE FLNG liquefied natural gas export terminal, which CE FLNG LLC also planned. The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission announced an environmental review of both in a December 2013 notice.<ref name="rd05654" /> A 2013 Natural Gas Intelligence article said FERC approved the pre-filing request for the terminal and gave a pipeline length of 45 to 72 miles.<ref name="r194912">{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/news/lng-export-import-terminal-proposals-advance-mostly/|title=LNG Export, Import Terminal Proposals Advance -- Mostly|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-05}}</ref>

The Department of Energy said that on October 11, 2016 FERC ended its pre-filing review of the project because of a lack of progress. In January 2025 the department dismissed the pending part of the export application, noting that the company had not reported any concrete action in more than 12 years.<ref name="r970658" /> No source shows that the pipeline was built.
